title: An etale covering of an affine scheme is refined by a finite family of affine opens of its members
statement: Let $T$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $(t_i:T_i\to T)_{i\in I}$ a family of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism] which is jointly surjective ($T=\bigcup_it_i(T_i)$). Then there are $m\ge0$, indices $i(1),\dots,i(m)\in I$ and affine open subschemes $U_j\subseteq T_{i(j)}$ ($j=1,\dots,m$) such that $T=\bigcup_{j=1}^mt_{i(j)}(U_j)$. In particular $\{t_{i(j)}|_{U_j}:U_j\to T\}_{j=1,\dots,m}$ is a family of etale morphisms from affine schemes (an open immersion is etale and a composite of etale morphisms is etale), jointly surjective, and it refines $(t_i)_{i\in I}$: each $U_j\to T$ factors through $t_{i(j)}$ via the open immersion $U_j\hookrightarrow T_{i(j)}$.
